amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:64` still runs only feed leaching, mineralization, and nitrification, and the only new chemistry change is the nitrification alkalinity debit at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366`. `crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs:26` still has no suboxic-zone or denitrifier state to read from. As a result, this patch does not implement the bead’s core behavior: nitrate is never reduced to N2, the rate never depends on NO3/DOC/suboxic volume, and denitrification alkalinity is never returned.
amendments.rationale: This is the primary deliverable for the bead. Without it, nitrate still accumulates indefinitely and most acceptance criteria remain unmet.

amendments.body: The denitrification parameter surface and defaults are still missing. `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:49` defines only the existing decomposer/nitrifier parameters plus a reserved constant, but there are no named fields for denitrifier activity, NO3 half-saturation, DOC half-saturation, or the pore-water diffusion/mixing factor. The default process pack also still stops at nitrification stoichiometry in `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml:52`.
amendments.rationale: The bead explicitly requires all denitrification rate constants and half-saturation values to live in process data. Without those fields and defaults, the feature cannot be calibrated, serialized, or exercised through presets.

amendments.body: Explicit N2 export accounting is not wired. The only budget-model change is adding alkalinity to `BudgetDelta`/`BudgetTotals` in `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:67`, while the nitrogen budget guard in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:845` and `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:899` still only exempts open-system action fluxes. If denitrification starts removing nitrate inside `system:nitrogen_cycle`, it will be treated as an unexplained nitrogen leak instead of an explicit export path. The added test coverage also does not check any of the bead’s denitrification cases; `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1` is entirely about nitrification/alkalinity.
amendments.rationale: The deliverable requires denitrification to appear as an intentional permanent export in diagnostics. The current budget plumbing cannot represent that requirement.

payload.summary: I found three blocking gaps. The patch is an alkalinity/nitrification instrumentation change, not the denitrification implementation requested by the bead; the required denitrification parameters/defaults are absent; and the budget guard still cannot represent system-level N2 export as an explicit nitrogen outflow.
